article.headline: Pyke scores 22 in Incarnate Word's 97-53 win against Southwestern (TX)
article.description: — Jordan Pyke's 22 points helped Incarnate Word defeat Southwestern (Texas) 97-53 on Friday.
article.linkText: Pyke scores 22 in Incarnate Word's 97-53 win against Southwestern (TX)

categories.description: Southwestern U Pirates @ Incarnate Word Cardinals

event.description: Southwestern U Pirates @ Incarnate Word Cardinals

keywords: Southwestern U Pirates @ Incarnate Word Cardinals
article.story: SAN ANTONIO -- — Jordan Pyke's 22 points helped Incarnate Word defeat Southwestern (Texas) 97-53 on Friday. Pyke had five rebounds for the Cardinals (1-1). Dylan Hayman scored 17 points and added six rebounds and four steals. Davion Bailey shot 4 of 10 from the field, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 5 from the line to finish with 15 points, while adding three steals. The Pirates were led in scoring by Jared Robins and Aedan Lewis with nine points apiece. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
